t: Stay and Play at Treehouse Hotels
Treehouse Hotel London
s: The large bay windows have uninterrupted views over the city skyline, and you can spot landmarks such as The Shard, Canary Wharf and The London Eye. Rooms come with rainforest showers and desks. Some of the suites have window seating where you can read a book or simply soak up the views. In keeping with the tree house inspiration, the furniture is made from natural and vintage materials, and there are plenty of plants to add colour. For contemporary Mexican cuisine with a view, book a table at Madera at the Treehouse London.
